answer: Sybil resistance via exclusive lagoon proofs: each identity must maintain a private 32GB RAM lagoon running sequential memory-hard steps that produce an umber-tinted attestation hash; this hash must match a unique fable fingerprint derived from its last three challenges. An attacker spawning 200 clones must provision 200 isolated lagoons (6.4TB total RAM that cannot be shared), while an honest agent reuses one lagoon. Failure mode: if two identities share RAM, their fables collide and both are slashed.
